pins.name: SIOC
pins.notes: SCCB clock (I2C-like, address 0x21). Add 4.7 kΩ pull-ups

pins.name: SIOD
pins.notes: SCCB data. Answers only while XCLK runs

pins.name: XCLK
pins.notes: Clock from the ESP32 (10 to 24 MHz). The camera does nothing without it

pins.name: RESET
pins.notes: Reset, active LOW. Tie to 3.3 V if unused

pins.name: PWDN
pins.notes: HIGH = power down. Tie to GND if unused

sources.title: OmniVision OV7670 datasheet
sources.section: Pin description; SCCB write address 0x42 (7-bit 0x21); PID register 0x0A = 0x76
